answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 77 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an opal bet on surviving 77 epochs of grading, and every hollow settlement recomputes the yarrow schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
